headline: Enforcement orders for 5 Appleton Street and 98 Lower Westfield Road, plus a friendly enforcement order for 461 Northampton Street.
summary: An executive order on tree pit restoration, stump removal, and urban tree planting is up for discussion. A Demographic, Health & Environmental Equity Profile, the ReGreen Springfield Report, is also on the agenda.
items: Continued enforcement order: grading and fill along about 470 lineal feet of banks at 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006), near the Connecticut River
Enforcement order: illegal dumping and altering of a vegetated wetland within the 200-foot buffer of Tannery Brook at 98 Lower Westfield Road (MBP: 174-00-021)
Discussion of friendly enforcement order at 461 Northampton Street (MBP: 223-00-011)
Discussion of executive order on tree pit restoration, stump removal, and urban tree planting
Discussion of Demographic, Health & Environmental Equity Profile, ReGreen Springfield Report
Discussion of upcoming items for 10/8/26 meeting
